sys_data_source.name: CLM Outstanding last 6 months_test
sys_data_source.sql_statement:
SELECT TIME_SID, CUSTOMER, ZONE, STATE_DESC_I2, DEPOT_DESC_I2, SEGMENT,
PAN_NO, PARENT_NAME, PARENT_CODE, CHILD_NAME, REL_PARTY, SECURITY_DEPOSIT,
CREDIT_LIMIT, SORG, COMP_CODE,
AGING_0_21_DAYS, AGING_22_30_DAYS, AGING_31_45_DAYS, AGING_46_60_DAYS,
AGING_61_75_DAYS, AGING_76_90_DAYS, AGING_91_120_DAYS, AGING_121_180_DAYS,
AGING_181_365_DAYS, AGING_366_730_DAYS, AGING_730_DAYS_ABOVE,
ACTUAL_ADVANCE_BEFORE_ADJUSTMENT, TOTAL_UGHAI_BEFORE_ADJUSTMENT,
UGHAI_AFTER_ADJUSTMENT, BALANCE_ADVANCE_AFTER_ADJUSTMENT, UGHAI_RECLASSIFIED, TPC_CODE,
TPC_NAME, NET_BALANCE, PAN_BASED
FROM (
SELECT TIME_SID, CUSTOMER, ZONE, STATE_DESC_I2, DEPOT_DESC_I2, SEGMENT,
PAN_NO, PARENT_NAME, PARENT_CODE, CHILD_NAME, REL_PARTY, SECURITY_DEPOSIT,
CREDIT_LIMIT, SORG, COMP_CODE,
"0-21 days" AS AGING_0_21_DAYS,
"22-30 days" AS AGING_22_30_DAYS,
"31-45 days" AS AGING_31_45_DAYS,
"46-60 days" AS AGING_46_60_DAYS,
"61-75 days" AS AGING_61_75_DAYS,
"76-90 days" AS AGING_76_90_DAYS,
"91-120 days" AS AGING_91_120_DAYS,
"121-180 days" AS AGING_121_180_DAYS,
"181-365 days" AS AGING_181_365_DAYS,
"366-730 days" AS AGING_366_730_DAYS,
"730 days above" AS AGING_730_DAYS_ABOVE,
ACTUAL_ADVANCE_BEFORE_ADJUSTMENT, TOTAL_UGHAI_BEFORE_ADJUSTMENT,
UGHAI_AFTER_ADJUSTMENT, BALANCE_ADVANCE_AFTER_ADJUSTMENT, UGHAI_RECLASSIFIED, TPC_CODE,
TPC_NAME, NET_BALANCE, PAN_BASED,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
PARTITION BY CUSTOMER, FLOOR(TIME_SID / 100)
ORDER BY TIME_SID DESC
) AS rn
FROM cognos.VW_F_MKT_OUTSTANDING_DAILY_PAN
WHERE TIME_SID BETWEEN
TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(TRUNC(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -6), 'MM'), 'YYYYMMDD'))
AND
TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -1)), 'YYYYMMDD'))
-- Change "=" to "IN" and paste your comma-separated list inside the parentheses
AND CUSTOMER IN (
'630207P185'
)
)
WHERE rn = 1
